description.en: Internal per-frame driver for the camera-control system: advances the current queued camera movement (linear position/reference interpolation, or an orbit-based distance/angle interpolation), or if no movement is queued, keeps the camera locked onto its follow target. Called automatically once per frame by CallEvent and its siblings (CallKiznaxEvent, CallShopEvent, CallMasterAvatar) — scripts don't normally call it directly.
The event context's camera-control state table (subev_ctx.cam_ctrl), as set up by CamCtrlInit.
No explicit return statement (an early `return;` with no value on some paths) — implicitly null.

example.code:
// Drive the camera-control system once per frame inside an event's main loop (as CallEvent does internally)
sysCamCtrlStep(subev_ctx.cam_ctrl);
